recent_news.headline: Darling Ingredients to Release Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
recent_news.summary: Darling Ingredients announced it will host a conference call on July 30, 2026, at 9 a.m. ET to discuss Q2 2026 financial results. The company processes animal by-products and produces renewable fuels through its joint venture Diamond Green Diesel.

recent_news.headline: Operation Safe Driver Week 2026: Tank Operations Face July Enforcement Scrutiny
recent_news.summary: Wastewater, food-grade, petroleum, and other tank operations face heightened enforcement during Operation Safe Driver Week 2026 in mid-July. The campaign targets unsafe driving behaviors including hard cornering and excessive speed on ramps, which pose elevated risks for tanker vehicles carrying liquids.
